svg.text: What belongs to one city does not exist for the other

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An order, a restaurant, a file or a person of Tehran is “not found” for somebody of Istanbul, never “forbidden”,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: because “forbidden” would say that it exists. Scenario S6 asks it of five services.
